team.name: Xuyang Zhao
team.functions: F10 Registration; F11 Login; F12 Logout

cases.name: Account registration
cases.description: Create a customer account and reject incomplete or inconsistent registration data.
cases.deps: No existing customer is required; the demo registration service must be available.
cases.pre: Fresh guest session; unique generated example.invalid address; synthetic Account Test identity; no newsletter subscription.
scenarios: Valid new registration
Generated unique email; valid names and telephone; matching generated passwords; privacy choice checked
1. Open registration. 2. Fill valid synthetic details. 3. Select No for newsletter. 4. Check the privacy choice. 5. Click Continue.
Route account/success; content confirms Your Account Has Been Created!; the account is available to later login tests.
Missing required first name
Blank first name; otherwise valid fields and a different generated address
1. Open registration in a fresh session. 2. Fill all fields except first name. 3. Submit with privacy choice checked.
Remain at account/register; first-name validation message; first-name input is still blank.
Password confirmation mismatch
Valid generated address; generated password; confirmation DifferentPassword123!
1. Open registration in a fresh session. 2. Enter otherwise valid fields with different password confirmation. 3. Submit.
Remain at account/register; Password confirmation does not match password! is displayed.

cases.name: Account login
cases.description: Authenticate a registered customer and reject incorrect or empty credentials.
cases.deps: F10 provisions a valid test account through the registration UI; provisioning failure is a setup failure.
cases.pre: Fresh guest session; run-generated account for valid and wrong-password scenarios; no personal credentials.
scenarios: Valid credentials
Run-generated account email and matching password
1. Ensure the test account exists through registration UI and log it out. 2. Open login. 3. Enter valid credentials. 4. Click Login.
Route account/account; My Account section and Logout link are visible.
Incorrect password
Registered test email; IncorrectPassword123!
1. Ensure the test account exists and is signed out. 2. Submit its email with an incorrect password.
Remain at account/login; no authenticated Logout link; No match for E-Mail Address and/or Password. warning.
Blank credentials
Empty email and password
1. Open login in a fresh session. 2. Leave both fields blank. 3. Click Login.
Remain at account/login; login controls remain visible; no authenticated Logout link; invalid-credentials warning.

cases.name: Account logout
cases.description: End an authenticated session, deny protected access after logout, and permit subsequent sign-in and sign-out.
cases.deps: F10 account provisioning and F11 authenticated access; each scenario establishes its own signed-in session.
cases.pre: Fresh browser session; synthetic registered test customer; sign in through the UI before every scenario.
scenarios: Normal logout and account revisit
Authenticated test customer; Logout then Continue
1. Sign in. 2. Click the actual Logout link. 3. Check confirmation. 4. Click Continue to home. 5. Revisit My Account.
Logout confirmation; Continue opens home; account revisit redirects to account/login; login controls visible and Logout absent.
Protected profile after logout
Authenticated test customer; account/edit requested after logout
1. Sign in. 2. Click Logout. 3. Navigate directly to the protected profile-edit route.
Redirect to account/login; login controls visible; protected first-name field is absent.
New session and second logout
Same registered customer; login then logout twice
1. Sign in and log out. 2. Submit valid login credentials again. 3. Verify authenticated account. 4. Log out again. 5. Revisit account.
Second login succeeds; second logout confirms completion; account revisit requires login again.
